programme.title: Football - Spanish League: Malaga - Racing 07.11.
programme.desc: Primera or popularly La Liga is the first Spanish football league. With as many as 22 European Championship titles won, the Spanish Premier League has been considered the best European football league for years. Founded in 1929, Primera has 20 teams that try to collect the most points in the 38 rounds of the season. Real Madrid managed to do that the most times, while the second most successful team is Barcelona. In addition to the top teams, the Spanish league is also characterized by the extremely technical mentality of the game of most clubs with the aim of outplaying the opponent.

programme.title: Basketball - Euroleague: Milan - Fenerbahce
programme.desc: The Euroleague is a competition that began its journey into the world of European basketball under the name European Champions Cup way back in 1958, and the first trophy was won by the ASK Riga team from the then USSR, i.e. today's Latvia. FIBA had the main say in this competition until 2000 when the clubs took control of the competition through their association Eurolegaue Basketball. The format of the competition has changed throughout history and included a group stage, followed by eliminations in the playoffs. The winner of this competition is decided at the final tournament called the Final Four. The most successful clubs in this competition are Real Madrid, CSKA Moscow, Maccabi Tel-Aviv, Panathinaikos, Varese, Olympiakos.

programme.title: Basketball - Euroleague: Efes - ASVEL
programme.desc: The Euroleague is a competition that began its journey into the world of European basketball under the name European Champions Cup way back in 1958, and the first trophy was won by the ASK Riga team from the then USSR, i.e. today's Latvia. FIBA had the main say in this competition until 2000 when the clubs took control of the competition through their association Eurolegaue Basketball. The format of the competition has changed throughout history and included a group stage, followed by eliminations in the playoffs. The winner of this competition is decided at the final tournament called the Final Four. The most successful clubs in this competition are Real Madrid, CSKA Moscow, Maccabi Tel-Aviv, Panathinaikos, Varese, Olympiakos.

programme.title: The race
programme.desc: The Brazilian Grand Prix takes place at the legendary Autodromo José Carlos Pace in Interlagos. This event promises to be crucial for the young Italian prodigy Kimi Antonelli, who largely dominates the world championship, at the wheel of his Mercedes.

programme.title: The podium
programme.desc: The anthems, the presentation of trophies to the drivers who finished in the first three places, the traditional champagne flowing freely: the entire podium ceremony of today's Formula 1 Grand Prix to follow with the Canal+ teams!

programme.title: Formula One, the mag
programme.desc: “Formula One, the mag” presents Formula 1 news. Latest results, upcoming races, driver interviews, analysis of results with the channel's team of experts, everything can be discovered in “Formula One, the mag”.

programme.title: Teranga lion cubs
programme.desc: Their names are Léo, Naïm, Stelio, Axel, Matthias, Tiago, Timothée,... They are perhaps the future stars of Ligue 1. In the meantime, they are continuing their training with the under-16s of Olympique Lyonnais. For a week, these young footballers discovered Senegal. Between diving into a new culture and sporting adventures, the story of an unforgettable journey.

programme.title: End of programs
programme.desc: Closure of the antenna at the end of the day's broadcasts.

programme.title: Golf: WTGL
programme.desc: The WTGL, a new women's team golf competition, is inaugurated this season. The Boston team, led in particular by Lottie Woad, welcomes Detroit, which can count on Lexi Thompson and Jeen Thitikull.

programme.title: The 5th round
programme.sub-title: Hatton Triumphs In Dubai, McIlroy Wins The Race To Dubai For The 8th Time
programme.desc: In the golf magazine "Le 5e tour", a look back at the most beautiful American or European tournament of the last weekend with a summary of the first three rounds, a broad summary of the last round, accompanied by interviews and images. Thus, all the news from the PGA Tour and the DP World Tour are covered in this meeting for fans of the little white ball and the world golf circuits.

programme.title: The highlights
programme.desc: The Geneva Grand Prix took place on September 19 and 20 as part of the SailGP series. Already victorious five times before this Swiss stage, Australia intended to confirm its domination on Lake Geneva. Spain and Great Britain were also among the favorites to win and race to qualify for the grand final in Abu Dhabi at the end of the year.

programme.title: The super special
programme.desc: While the 2026 world champion was going to be crowned at the end of the Rally Italy Sardinia, the last super special was going to offer memorable suspense, and go down in rally legend.

programme.title: Golf+, the mag
programme.sub-title: Hatton Triumphs In Dubai, McIlroy Ties Montgomerie With His 8th Race
programme.desc: All the golf news from the world tours: the best shots from the American and European circuits, player portraits, analyzes and results with the editorial journalists and consultants. All information from the PGA Tour, PGA Tour Champions and women's tournaments are also covered in the magazine, which also covers the latest results and rankings.

programme.title: History of rugby champions
programme.desc: History of rugby champions revisits the great figures and notable moments of rugby, retracing the journeys, exploits and episodes which shaped the legend of the oval.

programme.title: Provence Rugby / Oyonnax
programme.desc: Summit match and gala poster this evening in Aix-en-Provence between the two reference teams of the Pro D2 championship, who occupied the first two places in the ranking at the end of the 6th day.

programme.title: Rugby evening
programme.sub-title: Provence Leading Pro D2, Les Bleus Prepare To Face Fiji
programme.desc: All the summaries of the evening's Pro D2 matches, interviews and analyses, with the channel's experts. Plus, before each day of Top 14, all the latest information and the compositions of the teams competing.

programme.title: Pro D2 pre-match
programme.desc: The final information before the Pro D2 match, the team compositions and the stakes of the meeting.

programme.title: Grenoble / Provence Rugby
programme.desc: After taking the lead in the championship following its success against Oyonnax (32-23), Provence Rugby travels to Grenoble, 4th after a misstep at Soyaux-Angoulême (30-24). In their long-distance duel for supremacy in Pro D2 (while Oyonnax hosts Brive at the same time), Philippe Saint-André's men will have to work hard to seek victory at the Stade des Alpes, facing an Isère team determined to resume its march forward.

programme.title: Pro D2 post-match
programme.desc: Following the Pro D2 meeting, the magazine reviews the latest news, reactions from players and coaches and offers the first post-match analyses.

programme.title: 1st round
programme.desc: Who will succeed Finnish Sami Välimäki, winner of the event a year ago? The Sea Island Open is the last meeting of the FedExCup Fall, and this first day will be rich in lessons.

programme.title: Zapsport 360
programme.desc: Zapsport 360 allows you to find all the significant images of recent sport, in a dynamic format: results, current competitions and spectacular sequences are there.

programme.title: Free practice 1
programme.desc: To discover this season new single-seaters Hybrid engine: 50% of the total power of the powertrain now comes from electric energy. Active aerodynamics: replacement of DRS with a system of movable front and rear wings....

programme.title: The best moments

programme.title: The Flying Guillotine
programme.desc: Ma Teng is one of the 'Flying Guillotine Squad', a group of killers commissioned by the Emperor Yung. When he starts to question the morality of his missions, he becomes a fugitive hunted by his former comrades.

programme.title: The Shepherd Girl
programme.desc: The Shepherd Girl, a heartwarming 1963 musical from Shaw Brothers! In this musical drama, Julie Yeh Feng stars as Hsiu Hsiu, a beautiful shepherd girl who falls in love with a handsome boatman named Liu Ta-lung

programme.title: Danger Has Two Faces
programme.desc: Many years ago, Inspector Kam killed an innocent man and decided to resign from the police force. He became a professional killer who disguises as a pet store owner.

programme.title: Guess Who Killed My 12 Lovers?
programme.desc: Six guitar playing, rock and roll singing and dancing young people on a boating trip are stranded on a rural island off of Hong Kong during a typhoon. They become suspicious of a woman (Jenny Hu) who matches the radio bulletin description of a murderess who killed twelve men. Can she be trusted? Is she laying a trap for a local youth (Chin Han) housesitting a mansion?

programme.title: The Bells Of Death
programme.desc: Amidst fountains of blood and guts, The Bells Of Death is a whirlwind story about a man embarking on a lifes journey to learn the sword, then gain revenge on the three men who killed his family and abducted his sister.

programme.title: Family Light Affair
programme.desc: After his hit directorial debut Let's Make Laugh, Alfred Cheung Kin-ting returns with this comedic clash of cultures when a Mainland Chinese peasant takes his family to Hong Kong.

programme.title: The Kung-Fu Instructor
programme.desc: Wong Yang is a famous martial artist who is forced to teach kung fu to the Mong Clan, an evil clan which is trying to destroy its nemesis, the Chow Clan.

programme.title: Tropicana Interlude
programme.desc: Ping and Su are lovers who operate a travel agency specializing in Southeast Asian holidays. Tung, a school mistress, and her students join a guided tour lead by Ping.

programme.title: Kid From Kwangtung
programme.desc: When an Anti-Ching chief is killed, his family flees to a small town populated by quarreling students and formidable gym coaches. However, one teacher is also an undercover agent.

programme.title: Tales Of Larceny
programme.desc: Li Han Hsiang wrote and directed Tales of Larceny, a story of scams and deceit during the corrupt Chinese Warlord era, featuring top character actors from Shaw Brothers' roster.

programme.title: What Price Honesty
programme.desc: Danny Lee, Jason Pai and Sun Chien play newly-recruited law enforcers whose crime-fighting is hampered by their corrupt superiors, in this period-set martial arts thriller.

programme.title: The Secret Of The Dirk
programme.desc: The inhabitants of the City of Liu are forced to flee when the vicious Black Tigers gang raids their city, but are able to hide all their gold and treasures in a valley.

programme.title: Torrent Of Desire
programme.desc: David is falling in love with a fashion model Dan Feng and marries her. David's sister Mona is in love with his best friend Han Ming. Out of jealousy, Mona lies to him about a fake affair between Han Ming and Dan Feng.

programme.title: Tales Of A Eunuch
programme.desc: The story follows a 'loveable' rascal as he gambles and gets into various bits of trouble with outlaws and rebels. The whole movie revolves around a quest for all the copies of a special Buddhist text.

programme.title: Passing Flickers
programme.desc: An amusing insider's look at the Hong Kong film industry from Li Han Hsiang, recreating some of the era's funniest and most surreal stories ripped straight from the gossip.

programme.title: The 14 Amazons
programme.desc: The Yang family had served their country in Song Dynasty for generations. When General Yang is ambushed and killed during the war in Jin Shan, the grand matriarch led the family to take revenge and defend the country.

programme.title: Spring Blossoms
programme.desc: Some of Shaw Brothers' biggest female stars of the 1970s share the screen in this tale of young love and interfering parents, starring Lily Li, Shu Pei Pei and Essie Lin Chia.

programme.title: Lady Of Steel
programme.desc: Cheng Pei-pei was Hong Kong's most celebrated Queen of Kung-fu. Here she plays a swordswoman on a mission to avenge her parents murders and save the country from foreign invaders.

programme.title: The Adulteress
programme.desc: In the waning day of the Ching Dynasty, the son of the local magistrate murdered a peddler and raped his wife. The wife had been framed for her husband's murder by the rapist.

programme.title: Vengeance Is A Golden Blade
programme.desc: Convoy Master Li's wife has an affair with his rival Long, who plans to steal Li's Golden Blade and kill him as well as his young daughter.

programme.title: The Brave Archer 2
programme.desc: Kuo Tsing wins the hand of fair maiden Huang Yung. Almost immediately, however, clan rivalries leads to Kuo being wounded by Ouyang Feng and Huang being named new leader of the Beggar Clan.

programme.title: The Anonymous Heroes
programme.desc: Two young men join a rebel group after the Chinese Revolution of 1911 and become patriotic heroes accidentally. Assisted by a warlord's daughter, they successfully help the rebels steal weapons from the warlord.

programme.title: Rose, Be My Love
programme.desc: Set on the eve of the Japanese invasion of HK, this tragic Shaw Brothers romance stars Li Ting and Kwan Shan as young lovers torn apart by war.

programme.title: The Web Of Death
programme.desc: To rule the martial arts world, the Head of the Snake Sect seeks to possess a deadly plant called 'Five Poison Web', spreading rumours on its whereabouts. Brothers Xiong and Kit are sent to investigate.

programme.title: Return Of The Phoenix
programme.desc: Return Of The Phoenix is yet another masterpiece from director Li Han-hsiang. It is a comedy surrounded the upcoming marriage of the imperial minister's daughter.

programme.title: The Reckless Cricket
programme.desc: Inspired by “Drunken Master”, this kung fu comedy features a bumbling martial artist creating a cricket-style fighting arts to fight and defeat the different martial artists who have beaten him before.

programme.title: The Merry Wife
programme.desc: Li Ching, a 17-year-old girl who marries her 35-year-old teacher. Comedy ensues when Li decides to go to the same school with her husband but attempting to hide their relationship.

programme.title: The Knight Of Knights
programme.desc: Wen Su Chen, the leader of seven knights, sends his six sworn brothers to investigate a monastery. Unfortunately, they are killed by an abbot who plans to murder Inspector Lin.

programme.title: Big Times For Crazy Bumpkins
programme.desc: The crazy bumpkins return for the third time! Ah Niu is minding his own business when a bag of jewels falls from the sky. And that's just the beginning of a series of misadventures!

programme.title: The Silent Swordsman
programme.desc: A young swordsman is tasked to lead a patriotic secret society to fight the traitorous general who colludes with the enemy. At the same time, he encounters a female warrior and two beautiful princesses.

programme.title: The Venus' Tear Diamond
programme.desc: Legendary rival jewel thieves Fragrant Night and Nocturnal Earl travel to Japan to steal the famous Venus' Tear Diamond.

programme.title: The Duel Of The Century
programme.desc: A duel has been arranged at the Forbidden City between two formidable swordsmen of the martial world, Ye Gu Cheng and Xi Men Chui Xue. Lu Xiao Feng smells something fishy about the duel.

programme.title: Beyond The Great Wall
programme.desc: Wang Zhao Jun refuses to bribe the imperial painter, so he draws an ugly portrait of her, preventing her from being selected by the Emperor until they meet in person.

programme.title: Heroes Shed No Tears
programme.desc: Alexander Fu Sheng plays a man who is supposed to die at the hand of a sword with a teardrop forged onto the blade.

programme.title: Tragic Commitment
programme.desc: Alex is happily married to a gynecologist, Tung for five years. When Alex is fatally wounded in an accident, he feels obliged to tell Tung about his affair with Blackie.

programme.title: The Cave Of Silken Web
programme.desc: The 3rd part of Shaw Bros' Journey To The West sees sex and spectacle combine as our heroes are trapped by the seductive 7 Spiders, hellbent on achieving immortality by eating monks!

programme.title: The Shadow Boxing
programme.desc: Chan and his apprentice Fan transport vampires for a living. When two of them hopped away, it is revealed that one of them is actually a man in disguise trying to escape from his enemies.

programme.title: Super Inframan
programme.desc: Transformed from a young laboratory researcher, the thunderbolt-fisted Inframan must battle Princess Dragon Mom who wakes up from hibernation to conquer the earth with her army of mutant monsters.

programme.title: Sons Of Good Earth
programme.desc: An award winning movie for best script and best editing. Another tale of a Sino-Japanese war that artistically and emotional triumphed, it clearly portrays the life of wartime.

programme.title: Hex Vs Witchcraft
programme.desc: Yu Nan (Yi Lei) is a compulsive gambler. He makes his wife as a down payment for his debt, feeling regretted and decides to kill himself but stops when a beautiful ghost appears.

programme.title: The Convict Killer
programme.desc: A framed kung-fu master seeks revenge after 15 years in prison. He survives one attempt on his life after another! An intriguing, exciting production which weaves mystery and suspense with kung-fu action.

programme.title: The Human Goddess
programme.desc: This is a love story between an alluring fairy, Seventh Sister, who comes down from heaven to experience life in 70's Hong Kong, and a man who is running a debt laden orphanage.

programme.title: The Monkey Goes West
programme.desc: Another film inspired by the Chinese classic tale Journey to the West. This memorable version presents a unique interpretation with humour, action, and fantasy galore.

programme.title: Sex, Love And Hate
programme.desc: In Sex, Love And Hate, director of erotica and kung-fu films Chu Yuan combines stars from both genres to create a masterpiece about Hong Kong society's differing views on love and what women want from it.

programme.title: The Swift Knight
programme.desc: It's tale of brave knights, chivalry and fair maidens where the Swift Knight finds himself involved in romance, court intrigue and deadly jousts while trying to protect a baby who is the Emperor's secret heir apparent.

programme.title: The Snake Prince
programme.desc: Ti Lung who lives on the Snake Mountain of Kwangsi with his brothers the Black Snake and the Yellow Snake, have been trying to turn into humans for a thousand years.

programme.title: All Men Are Brothers
programme.desc: The patriotic story of seven warriors in the band of 108 outlaws at Mount Liang. The magnificent seven battle against the despotic government officials to save their country.

programme.title: The Mask Of Shura Of Fire Cloud
programme.desc: The Black Feather clan infiltrated the territory of Master Fire Cloud and stole The Mask of Shura, thus releasing an evil spirit that was a baby. Master Fire Cloud adopted the baby to prevent him from becoming evil.

programme.title: Lifeline
programme.desc: The story revolves around a dutiful yet indifferent fireman, who can march into disaster and risk his lives by saving others, yet would he have the equivalent courage to tackle his personal issues?

programme.title: Fierce Cop
programme.desc: To save his son who has been kidnapped by human traffickers, police officer Zhang teams up with a mysterious lady to crack the international crime syndicate and rescue his son.

programme.title: Ghost Wedding
programme.desc: A photographer is entangled with a 'woman in red', leading to the deaths of his relatives one by one. When the girl he likes also died mysteriously, Zhi Cheng vows to find out the truth.

programme.title: VR Fighter
programme.desc: Long Wei has post-traumatic stress disorder after his wife's death. One day, he encounters Amy who works for a VR technology firm and is invited for a new product test. After the test, he becomes the firm's VR fighter.

programme.title: When Fortune Smiles
programme.desc: The head of a rich family dies and in his will leaves his fortune to his daughter. His son is enraged and uses a rubbish collector who looks the same as his sister to steal the fortune. The Uncle's son also wants a piece of the fortune and coerces a small time thief into stealing the will for his wild scheme.

programme.title: Dragon Master: Dragon Spell
programme.desc: The Dragon King is locked in a seal by the Dragon Master for 500 years, and his daughter must travel back in the past to kill the Dragon Master as she know that they were close friends back then.

programme.title: Prince Charming
programme.desc: Chen Li Pin, the nerdy son of a business tycoon, and his friend seek love in Hawaii. Returning home in disappointment, they accidentally find themselves in a messy identity swap.

programme.title: Iceman: The Time Traveller (Celestial Movies)
programme.desc: The imperial guard and his three traitorous childhood friends ordered to hunt him down get accidentally buried and kept frozen in time. 400 years later pass and they are defrosted continuing the battle they left behind.

programme.title: Face To Face
programme.desc: Tamotsu dies in a skiing accident and his roommate Yoshio marries his wife as well as inherits his entire fortune. Things change, when Yoshio sees a badly disfigured old man at Tamotsu's funeral.

programme.title: The Grandmaster
programme.desc: Ip Man takes up a challenge by ageing northern master Gong Yu Tian. Ip Man wins the fight, but is then defeated by Gong Yu Tian's daughter Gong Er, with whom he forms an emotional bond.

programme.title: Love On Delivery
programme.desc: A delivery boy Yin wants to impress his dream girl Li, so he enrols in a martial arts course to learn strange moves. Being timid, Yin saves Li while wearing a Garfield mask but the credit is stolen by Karate Master, Liu. To prove himself and win Li back, Yin defeats Liu in the ring with his unique martial arts move Invincible Wind and Fire Spin.

programme.title: Get In The Dark
programme.desc: Miss Qiao had died in vain and her butler paid a paper craftsman to make a paper doll. Miss Qiao's spirit is revived to take revenge and a series of horrible events begins to happen.

programme.title: The Last Tycoon
programme.desc: Action superstar Chow Yun-Fat portrays real-life gangster Chen Daqi as he rises to the upper echelons of power, finding himself torn between the love of two women, the murderous plots of the secret service, and the looming threat of war.

programme.title: Fight Back To School 2
programme.desc: Sing quits the force after getting demoted to traffic duties, while his partner is assigned a mission involving foreign terrorists threatening to bomb a school in Hong Kong, so Sing decides to help by going undercover at the same school.

programme.title: The Revenge
programme.desc: Never take your mistress on an annual guys' getaway, especially one devoted to hunting - a violent lesson for three wealthy married men.

programme.title: The Mighty Peking Man
programme.desc: A greedy Hong Kong businessman hires a young hunter to capture a giant gorilla said to live deep in the Indian jungle. The hunter finds the ape, and living with it he finds a feral human female who has befriended the creature.

programme.title: Behind The Yellow Line
programme.desc: Behind The Yellow Line

programme.title: Munitions Hijacking Case
programme.desc: Agent Wen is assigned to work undercover for a Southeast Asian military arm dealer to find some munitions and to destroy them. When he finally finds the munitions though, he is attacked by unknown gangsters.

programme.title: How To Pick Girls Up!
programme.desc: Xin, a helpless loser in love, calls in to a radio show hosted by DJ Tsang to ask desperately for help. A self-proclaimed love expert, Tsang takes it upon himself to make sure Xin meets girls and leads him on a series of absurd excursions into the wild and dangerous world of modern love.

programme.title: Teenage Dreamers
programme.desc: This refreshing musical comedy tempers its fizzy charm with just enough tartness to insure its charming buoyancy. This light look at teenage life even won starlet Chou Hsiu-lan a Hong Kong Film Awards nomination for Best Newcomer.

programme.title: Furious Attack
programme.desc: A former special forces soldier infiltrates northern Myanmar to rescue his missing daughter, fighting against scam gangs and organ traffickers in a final showdown with the crime boss.

programme.title: Out Of The Dark (Celestial Movies)
programme.desc: An old lady died after falling off a building and her ghost appears to haunt the place. Freaked out by the haunting, the security guards invite ghostbuster Leo and his assistant to help.

programme.title: The Mad Monk
programme.desc: Stephen Chow plays an arrogant god in Heaven who is being punished for his pranks and mistakes. He is sent to Earth and reincarnate as Mad Monk to change the destiny of three misguided souls - a prostitute, a beggar and a villain. The Mad Monk needs to complete the task in three days in order to return to Heaven.

programme.title: The Viral Factor (Celestial Movies)
programme.desc: Agent Jon contemplates leaving the force until he learns his brother is working as a mercenary for a former colleague who betrayed their team.

programme.title: Mid-Night Two
programme.desc: The film tells the story of a group of people in order to search for treasure, traveled thousands of miles to the ancient legend of the ghost mountain, for thousands of years whoever have entered the ghost mountain all disappeared, it is said that the mountain buried a female body never decomposed, the Yin fire didn't extinguished in thousand of years, every 2:30 in the morning the Yin fire is the heaviest, all the ghosts would return.

programme.title: That Demon Within
programme.desc: A dutiful cop, guilt-ridden over saving the life of a gang leader, becomes obsessed with bringing down the crime syndicate of the man he saved.

programme.title: My Darling Genie
programme.desc: My Darling Genie

programme.title: Lost Memories
programme.desc: A failed assassination attempt in Harbin, China in 1909 changes the course of history. Now two JBI agents must find the connections between it and an ancient Korean artifact.

programme.title: Ip Man
programme.desc: During the Japanese invasion of China, a wealthy martial artist is forced to leave his home when his city is occupied. With little means of providing for themselves, Ip Man and the remaining members of the city must find a way to survive.

programme.title: Mr. Virgin
programme.desc: When a young man ignores a feng shui master's warning and decides to marry before turning 30, a series of mishaps begins to curse his life.

programme.title: Maybe It's Love
programme.desc: 10 year-old Marbles witness the murder of a young woman.

programme.title: Flying Swords Of Dragon Gate
programme.desc: Set three years after Dragon Inn, innkeeper Jade has disappeared and a new inn has risen from the ashes - one that's staffed by marauders masquerading as law-abiding citizens, who hope to unearth the fabled lost city buried in the desert.

programme.title: Challenge Of The Gamesters
programme.desc: Wong Jing created the gambling film genre almost singlehandedly, and in one of his earliest blockbusters, Shih Hsien leads a stellar cast in a tale of spies, tycoons and beautiful babes.

programme.title: Punish Evil
programme.desc: In 1990s China, a northern cop joins forces with a local detective in the southern city of Binhai to track down a ruthless gang responsible for a string of violent robberies. A battle of wits ensues between law enforcement and criminals.

programme.title: Legend Of The Dragon
programme.desc: Stephen Chow leaves for the big city to try and save his home by winning the huge snooker tournament.

programme.title: Rob-B-Hood (Celestial Movies)
programme.desc: Thongs and Octopus accept a job from their landlord: kidnap a baby. Soon, the baby awakens strong paternal feelings in the two crooks, leading to complications when it comes to handing him over to his possibly crazy gang boss grandfather.

programme.title: Vampire Vs Vampire (Celestial Movies)
programme.desc: A priest discovers that the water supply in his village has been contaminated by bats, and while in the process of digging a well to find new water supply, he inadvertently unearths the corpse of an evil Western priest.

programme.title: Mother Vs Mother
programme.desc: Guan De Xing fell in love with Li Xiao Yun when he was young, but was opposed by his mother and had to marry Zhou Shen Yu. Since then, Li holds a grudge against Zhou.

programme.title: Iron Kung Fu Fist
programme.desc: Liang Kun is a skilled martial arts master, he fights to avenge his lover's death with the help of a beggar gang leader.

programme.title: Fight Back To School 3
programme.desc: Police officer Chow Sing Sing is assigned to work undercover investigating the murder of millionaire Million Wong, to whom Chow has an uncanny resemblance, by posing as an amnesiac Wong.

programme.title: Sex Beyond The Grave
programme.desc: A woman is raped and murdered during World War 2. Forty years later she returns to haunt her persecutors from the Tao Tao Mansion. A professor and his family move into the house, only to have the spirits take their son.

programme.title: Young Heroes Of Chaotic Times
programme.desc: This story is set in Shanghai in the late Qing Dynasty, and talks about a young man, Chen Zhen, who rises to become a national hero after enduring hardships and overcoming challenges in life.

programme.title: Painted Face
programme.desc: An action-thriller centered on a vampire-like woman who eats the skins and hearts of her lovers.

programme.title: The Lost Bladesman
programme.desc: An epic historic adventure set during the turbulent times of the Three Kingdoms. Cao Cao attempts to enlist Guan Yu into his forces, but Guan is loyal to his sworn brother Liu Bei, who is also Cao's enemy.

programme.title: Young Ip Man: Crisis Time
programme.desc: The whole school is held hostage during the day of an English speech competition. As Ip Man decides to step up and rise to the crisis, it is revealed that his master and his childhood friend are behind all this.

programme.title: Shinjuku Incident
programme.desc: A simple Chinese immigrant wages a perilous war against one of the most powerful criminal organizations on the planet.

programme.title: Mahjong Heroes
programme.desc: A hero helps a young student deflect a cunning and malicious gambling tycoon who is out to take over the student’s family business over a game of mahjong.

programme.title: The Macaque Monkey
programme.desc: The world is in chaos after the tree of life was burnt. Sun Wu Kong decides to return to the past to resurrect it, but his divine power is unstable after losing the golden hoop.

programme.title: 36 Secrets Of Courtship
programme.desc: Three lotharios vie to become principal of the Macho Man Training School, an extremely non-monastic institution dedicated to extremely non Shaolin-types of physical exertion.

programme.title: Layar Drama RCTI - Terikat Takdir (Bhootu)
programme.desc: Pihu, arwah seorang anak perempuan berusia tujuh tahun, berusaha melindungi ibunya, Anandita, dari segala bahaya dengan bantuan teman sekaligus anak baptisnya, Krishna.

programme.title: Layar Drama Indonesia Malam : Jangan Bercerai Bunda (RR)
programme.desc: Nabila adalah seorang ibu dan wirausahawan yang memiliki tiga orang anak. Dalam kehidupan rumah tangganya bersama sang suami, Arga, berbagai lika-liku pun muncul. Terungkapnya perselingkuhan Arga dengan wanita lain membuat Nabila dihadapkan pada situasi yang penuh dengan pilihan.

programme.title: Layar Drama Indonesia Malam : Roman Picisan (RR)
programme.desc: Setelah lulus SMA, Roman melanjutkan studinya di Belanda bersama Sam dan terpaksa berpisah dengan Wulan. Hubungan asmara antara Roman dan Wulan, yang awalnya berjalan mulus, terusik oleh kehadiran Meira, seorang mahasiswi yang menjadi sahabat baru Roman di Belanda.

programme.title: Layar Drama Indonesia Malam : Anak Jalanan (RR)
programme.desc: Boy, seorang anak motor jagoan jalanan, dikagumi oleh banyak gadis. Namun, di dalam hati Boy hanya ada Adriana, mantan kekasihnya yang telah meninggalkannya. Boy kemudian bertemu dengan Reva, yang merasa takjub melihat kemampuannya dalam mengendalikan sepeda motor.

programme.title: Seputar iNews
programme.desc: Program berita yang menyajikan rangkuman berita-berita penting dan terkini yang terjadi di dalam dan luar negeri. Dari politik, ekonomi, hukum, hingga peristiwa sosial dan olahraga, semua dikupas tuntas di sini.

programme.title: Layar Drama Indonesia Pagi : Putri Untuk Pangeran (RR)
programme.desc: Putri adalah anak dari seorang wanita baik hati yang tidak menyadari bahwa dirinya merupakan keturunan malaikat. Demi membantu perekonomian keluarga, Putri bekerja keras hingga akhirnya bisa menempuh pendidikan di universitas. Ibunya adalah seorang orang tua tunggal. Berkat darah malaikat yang mengalir dalam dirinya, Putri memiliki kemampuan untuk mendengar suara hati setiap orang.

programme.title: Layar Drama Indonesia Pagi : Cinta Tanpa Karena (RR)
programme.desc: Perjalanan cinta Nuna dan Dipta harus menghadapi jalan yang terjal. Mulai dari terhalangnya restu orang tua, jarak yang memisahkan, hingga rasa cemas karena Dipta merupakan seorang abdi negara yang setiap harinya harus mempertaruhkan nyawa. Berbagai rintangan pun menguji kesetiaan cinta mereka.

programme.title: Go Spot Eksklusif
programme.desc: Program yang menayangkan Film dari berbagai genre seperti romansa dan komedi yang seru dan menghibur untuk disaksikan selama moment liburan.

programme.title: Layar Drama Indonesia Siang - Terikat Janji Selamanya
programme.desc: Davina Rosalia Kusuma, putri pengusaha, tampak hidup sempurna namun menyimpan luka sejak ibunya meninggal dan ayahnya menikah lagi. Ia merasa terasing, terlebih setelah cinta pertamanya, Ryan, menghilang. Sepuluh tahun kemudian, pertunangannya dengan Dipa hancur karena perselingkuhan dengan adik tirinya, Jihan. Di tengah keterpurukan, Davina bertemu Sena, penjual ketoprak yang ternyata polisi intel yang menyelidiki Dipa. Davina meminta Sena berpura-pura menjadi pacarnya, namun hubungan palsu itu berubah menjadi nyata. Tanpa ia tahu, Sena juga mencari kebenaran tentang hilangnya Ryanmembawa mereka pada rahasia, balas dendam, dan perasaan yang tak terduga.

programme.title: Layar Drama Indonesia Siang - Ikatan Cinta Aldebaran & Andin
programme.desc: Mengisahkan dua saudara perempuan bernama Andien dan Elsa. Keduanya tidak menyadari bahwa mereka sama-sama mencintai pria yang sama, yaitu Nino. Hubungan yang sudah renggang di antara mereka semakin memburuk setelah Elsa mengetahui bahwa Nino berencana menikahi Andien. Setelah menikah, Elsa memfitnah Andien hingga diceraikan Nino. Ditengah luka tersebut Andien bertemu dengan Aldebaran yang sengaja mendekati Andien untuk membalas dendam adiknya. Namun dengan kebaikan hati Andien, perlahan Aldebaran melihat kebenaran dan mulai jatuh cinta pada Andien

programme.title: Layar Drama Indonesia : Ternyata Ini Cinta
programme.desc: Setelah sebuah kecelakaan merenggut nyawa ayahnya, Luna kembali ke dunia balap liar. Persaingannya dengan Marco berubah menjadi kisah cinta, hingga rahasia mengenai status anak angkatnya dan geng Spider mengungkap kebenaran di balik kematian sang ayah.

programme.title: Layar Drama Indonesia : Terbaik Itu Kamu
programme.desc: Sera, putri pemilik perusahaan kosmetik Novelle Beauty, dijebak sebagai pembunuh Bram oleh tunangannya sendiri, Marvin, dan mantan kekasih Marvin, Clara. Akibat kesaksian palsu mereka, Sera dipenjara selama lima tahun dan kehilangan ayahnya, sementara sang adik, Wilda, membencinya karena percaya Sera telah membunuh kekasihnya. Setelah bebas, Sera kembali untuk membersihkan nama baiknya dan merebut kembali hidup yang telah direnggut darinya. Dalam penyamarannya untuk mencari bukti, Sera bertemu kembali dengan Kenzi, pria yang tanpa sengaja terlibat dalam kasus yang membuatnya dipenjara dan kini diam-diam berusaha melindunginya. Di tengah perebutan kekuasaan, rahasia masa lalu yang terpendam, dan dendam yang belum padam, benih cinta tumbuh di antara Sera dan Kenzi. Namun ketika kebenaran mulai terungkap, Sera harus memilih antara mempertahankan dendam atau membuka hatinya demi mendapatkan keadilan dan kebahagiaan yang selama ini hilang.

programme.title: Layar Drama Indonesia Malam : Terbelenggu Rindu Amira
programme.desc: Amira, seorang wanita berhati baik yang hidup bahagia bersama suami dan anaknya, harus menghadapi tragedi setelah Aditya berselingkuh. Suami dan putranya tewas dalam sebuah kecelakaan, begitu pula bayinya. Amira pun terpuruk dalam duka yang mendalam.

programme.title: Layar Drama Indonesia Siang - Terikat Janji Selamanya
programme.desc: Davina Rosalia Kusuma, putri pengusaha, tampak hidup sempurna namun menyimpan luka sejak ibunya meninggal dan ayahnya menikah lagi. Ia merasa terasing, terlebih setelah cinta pertamanya, Ryan, menghilang. Sepuluh tahun kemudian, pertunangannya dengan Dipa hancur karena perselingkuhan dengan adik tirinya, Jihan. Di tengah keterpurukan, Davina bertemu Sena, penjual ketoprak yang ternyata polisi intel yang menyelidiki Dipa. Davina meminta Sena berpura-pura menjadi pacarnya, namun hubungan palsu itu berubah menjadi nyata. Tanpa ia tahu, Sena juga mencari kebenaran tentang hilangnya Ryanmembawa mereka pada rahasia, balas dendam, dan perasaan yang tak terduga.

programme.title: Layar Drama Indonesia Siang - Ikatan Cinta Aldebaran & Andin
programme.desc: Mengisahkan dua saudara perempuan bernama Andien dan Elsa. Keduanya tidak menyadari bahwa mereka sama-sama mencintai pria yang sama, yaitu Nino. Hubungan yang sudah renggang di antara mereka semakin memburuk setelah Elsa mengetahui bahwa Nino berencana menikahi Andien. Setelah menikah, Elsa memfitnah Andien hingga diceraikan Nino. Ditengah luka tersebut Andien bertemu dengan Aldebaran yang sengaja mendekati Andien untuk membalas dendam adiknya. Namun dengan kebaikan hati Andien, perlahan Aldebaran melihat kebenaran dan mulai jatuh cinta pada Andien

programme.title: Layar Drama Indonesia : Ternyata Ini Cinta
programme.desc: Setelah sebuah kecelakaan merenggut nyawa ayahnya, Luna kembali ke dunia balap liar. Persaingannya dengan Marco berubah menjadi kisah cinta, hingga rahasia mengenai status anak angkatnya dan geng Spider mengungkap kebenaran di balik kematian sang ayah.

programme.title: Layar Drama Indonesia : Terikat Janji
programme.desc: Davina Rosalia Kusuma, putri pengusaha, tampak hidup sempurna namun menyimpan luka sejak ibunya meninggal dan ayahnya menikah lagi. Ia merasa terasing, terlebih setelah cinta pertamanya, Ryan, menghilang. Sepuluh tahun kemudian, pertunangannya dengan Dipa hancur karena perselingkuhan dengan adik tirinya, Jihan. Di tengah keterpurukan, Davina bertemu Sena, penjual ketoprak yang ternyata polisi intel yang menyelidiki Dipa. programme.title: Layar Drama Indonesia : Terbaik Itu Kamu
programme.desc: Sera, putri pemilik perusahaan kosmetik Novelle Beauty, dijebak sebagai pembunuh Bram oleh tunangannya sendiri, Marvin, dan mantan kekasih Marvin, Clara. Akibat kesaksian palsu mereka, Sera dipenjara selama lima tahun dan kehilangan ayahnya, sementara sang adik, Wilda, membencinya karena percaya Sera telah membunuh kekasihnya. Setelah bebas, Sera kembali untuk membersihkan nama baiknya dan merebut kembali hidup yang telah direnggut darinya. Dalam penyamarannya untuk mencari bukti, Sera bertemu kembali dengan Kenzi, pria yang tanpa sengaja terlibat dalam kasus yang membuatnya dipenjara dan kini diam-diam berusaha melindunginya. Di tengah perebutan kekuasaan, rahasia masa lalu yang terpendam, dan dendam yang belum padam, benih cinta tumbuh di antara Sera dan Kenzi. Namun ketika kebenaran mulai terungkap, Sera harus memilih antara mempertahankan dendam atau membuka hatinya demi mendapatkan keadilan dan kebahagiaan yang selama ini hilang.

programme.title: Layar Drama Indonesia Malam : Terbelenggu Rindu Amira
programme.desc: Amira, seorang wanita berhati baik yang hidup bahagia bersama suami dan anaknya, harus menghadapi tragedi setelah Aditya berselingkuh. Suami dan putranya tewas dalam sebuah kecelakaan, begitu pula bayinya. Amira pun terpuruk dalam duka yang mendalam.

programme.title: Kesetiaan
programme.desc: Nadya (ANGGIKA BOLSTERLI), seorang dosen sukses, telah menikah dengan Pram (OMAR DANIEL). Setelah Pram kehilangan pekerjaan dan berkali-kali gagal membangun bisnis karena insiden kecelakaan di masa lalu, Nadya menjadi tulang punggung keluarga. Merasa rendah diri, Pram berubah menjadi suami toxic yang suka merendahkan, mengontrol, dan selalu cemburu dengan istrinya, apalagi ada Aris (RIONALDO STOCKHORST) mantan pacar Nadya yang juga menjadi dosen di kampus, semakin membuat Pram menjadi insecure sebagai suami Nadya. Namun semua berubah ketika Nadya membawa Citra (KEYSHA ANGELICA), mahasiswinya yang sedang mengalami kesulitan hidup untuk tinggal di kostan milik Pram dan Nadya. Pram yang merasa minder dengan istrinya ternyata menemukan kenyamanan yang ia dambakan ketika bersama Citra??? Saksikan keseruan ceritanya dalam SINETRON TERBARU KESETIAAN

programme.desc: FC Porto nadal może pochwalić się kompletem zwycięstw w lidze. Ma ich już na koncie 10, a w poprzednim meczu pokonało Estoril 4:0. O przedłużenie tej imponującej serii podopieczni Francesco Farioliego powalczą w 11. kolejce na wyjeździe z Vitorią SC.

programme.title: Liga włoska - mecz: SSC Napoli - SS Lazio
programme.desc: Azzurri stracili sporo punktów w bieżącym sezonie Serie A, w efekcie ligowa czołówka im uciekła. Przed nimi mecz z będącym na fali zespołem Biancocelestich, który po dziewięciu kolejkach był liderem tabeli.

programme.title: Liga niemiecka - mecz: 1. FSV Mainz 05 - FC Bayern Monachium
programme.desc: W poprzedniej ligowej kampanii Mainz potrafiło postawić Bawarczykom trudne warunki. Die Roten wywieźli co prawda z Mewa Areny cenne zwycięstwo, lecz Zero-Piątki strzeliły im aż trzy gole (4:3). Trzymamy kciuki, by w 9. kolejce sezonu 2026/27 obie ekipy stworzyły równie ciekawe widowisko.

programme.title: Bundesliga Clubs
programme.desc: 1. FC Union BerlinTwórcy serii odsłaniają kulisy funkcjonowania klubów grających na szczeblu niemieckiej Bundesligi.

programme.title: Pierwszy tytuł Kloppa
programme.desc: Jürgen Klopp poprowadził Borussię Dortmund do mistrzostwa Bundesligi w sezonie 2010/2011. Było to pierwsze znaczące trofeum w karierze niemieckiego trenera. O sile prowadzonego przez niego zespołu stanowiło wówczas trzech Polaków: Robert Lewandowski, Jakub Błaszczykowski i Łukasz Piszczek.

programme.title: Liga włoska - mecz: Venezia FC - Udinese Calcio
programme.desc: Trener Kosta Runjaić zapłacił posadą za słabe wyniki Udinese. Jego następcą został Javier Zanetti, który zadebiutuje w roli szkoleniowca Zebr w meczu przeciwko Venezii. Arancioneroverdi są jednymi z ich bezpośrednich rywali w walce o utrzymanie.

programme.title: Legendy Bundesligi
programme.desc: Karl-Heinz RummeniggeBiografie postaci, które trwale zapisały się w historii niemieckiej Bundesligi. W programie m.in. wywiady z zasłużonymi piłkarzami oraz klubowymi działaczami. Widzowie zapoznają się także z wypowiedziami ekspertów piłkarskich.

programme.title: Najlepsi napastnicy Bundesligi lat 90
programme.desc: Stefan Kuntz, Mario Basler, Fredi Bobic, Ulf Kirsten, Toni Polster i wielu innych zachwycało kibiców swoimi umiejętnościami na boiskach Bundesligi w latach 90. ubiegłego stulecia. W programie przyjrzymy się sylwetkom łowców bramek i oczywiście najpiękniejszym golom w ich bogatych kolekcjach.

programme.title: Podróż do świata Calcio
programme.desc: Podróż do świata Calcio.

programme.title: Bundesliga Dino
programme.desc: Historia Hamburgera SV, jednego z najbardziej utytułowanych klubów piłkarskich Bundesligi. Twórcy analizują m.in. sezon 2017/2018, kiedy popularne Dinozaury po raz pierwszy w swojej historii spadły z najwyższej klasy rozgrywkowej.

programme.title: Liga niemiecka - mecz: Borussia Dortmund - SV 07 Elversberg
programme.desc: Borussia Dortmund rzutem na taśmę zremisowała w poprzedniej kolejce z Bayernem Monachium, zdobywając bramkę w 89. minucie. Teraz Dortmundczycy zmierzą się u siebie z SV 07 Elversberg. Goście wygrali w miniony weekend wysoko z 1. FSV Mainz 05 4:1.

programme.title: Liga włoska - mecz: ACF Fiorentina - Juventus FC
programme.desc: Poprzednie ligowe spotkanie z Juventusem Fiorentina wygrała 2:0. Podrażnieni Bianconeri nie mogą pozwolić sobie powtórkę takiego rezultatu. Na obecnym etapie sezonu tracą już bowiem 11 punktów do lidera Serie A.

programme.title: Olympique Lyon - Między legendą a teraźniejszością
programme.desc: Olympique Lyon to jeden z najsłynniejszych klubów we Francji. Jego złota era przypadła na pierwszą dekadę XXI wieku, kiedy to siedmiokrotnie sięgnął po mistrzostwo Ligue 1. Twórcy filmu przypominają tamte sukcesy i przedstawiają wyzwania obecnie stojące przed Les Gones.

programme.title: Ousmane Dembélé - Pierwsze kroki
programme.desc: Ousmane Dembélé - Pierwsze kroki.

programme.title: Liga portugalska - mecz: Estrela Amadora - SL Benfica
programme.desc: SL Benfica przegrała w tym sezonie ligowym tylko z FC Porto i przed 11. kolejką traci do niego pięć punktów. Jeśli Orły chcą pozostać w walce o mistrzostwo, nie mogą sobie pozwolić na kolejną stratę punktów. O komplet oczek powalczą na wyjeździe z Estrelą Amadora, która ma za sobą gorszy okres - przegrała cztery ligowe mecze z rzędu.

Odskoczyć od niej i zmniejszyć stratę do czołówki spróbuje starciem z Monzą. Beniaminek zdobył w tej kampanii zaledwie 7 punktów i jest jednym z kandydatów do opuszczenia Serie A.

Przybliżyć się do niej spróbuje pojedynkiem z Toulouse. Gospodarze zanotowali spadek formy, zdobywając tylko oczko w ostatnich dwóch seriach gier, nie trafiając przy tym do bramki rywala.

Odskoczyć od niej i zmniejszyć stratę do czołówki spróbuje starciem z Monzą. Beniaminek zdobył w tej kampanii zaledwie 7 punktów i jest jednym z kandydatów do opuszczenia Serie A.

programme.title: Liga niemiecka - mecz: Hamburger SV - Borussia Mönchengladbach
programme.desc: Podopieczni Merlina Polzina są w słabej dyspozycji - przegrali dwa mecze z rzędu. W poprzedniej kolejce ulegli na wyjeździe Eintrachtowi Frankfurt 1:3. W kolejnym spotkaniu Hamburger SV zmierzy się u siebie z ostatnią w tabeli Borussią Mönchengladbach. Gospodarze nie mogą jednak zlekceważyć przyjezdnych, zwłaszcza że ci punktowali w dwóch poprzednich meczach. Najpierw wygrali 3:2 z VfB Stuttgart, a następnie bezbramkowo zremisowali z SC Paderborn 07.

programme.title: Liga francuska - mecz: Toulouse FC - RC Strasbourg
programme.desc: Strasbourg w poprzedniej kolejce ograł Auxerre 5:1 i tym samym wydostał się ze strefy spadkowej. Teraz chce rozpocząć pogoń za ligową czołówką, do której traci 5 punktów. Przybliżyć się do niej spróbuje pojedynkiem z Toulouse. Gospodarze zanotowali spadek formy, zdobywając tylko oczko w ostatnich dwóch seriach gier, nie trafiając przy tym do bramki rywala.

programme.title: Werder Double
programme.desc: Twórcy przypominają historyczny sezon Werderu zakończony zdobyciem podwójnej korony: mistrzostwa Bundesligi i Pucharu Niemiec. W rozgrywkach 2003/2004 trenerem zespołu z Bremy był Thomas Schaaf. Zielono-białe barwy reprezentowali wówczas m.in. Angelos Charisteas,Christian Schulz i Frank Baumann.

programme.title: Pierwszy tytuł Kloppa
programme.desc: Jürgen Klopp poprowadził Borussię Dortmund do mistrzostwa Bundesligi w sezonie 2010/2011. Było to pierwsze znaczące trofeum w karierze niemieckiego trenera. O sile prowadzonego przez niego zespołu stanowiło wówczas trzech Polaków: Robert Lewandowski, Jakub Błaszczykowski i Łukasz Piszczek.

programme.title: Najlepsze gole VfL Wolfsburg
programme.desc: Edin Dżeko, Grafite, a także Andrzej Juskowiak to tylko trzech wybitnych napastników, którzy zdobywali gole w barwach Wolfsburga. W szeregach tej drużyny występowało bowiem wielu klasowych snajperów. W programie zobaczymy najładniejsze bramki zdobyte przez piłkarzy Wilków.

programme.title: Liga portugalska - mecz: Vitoria SC - FC Porto
programme.desc: FC Porto nadal może pochwalić się kompletem zwycięstw w lidze. Ma ich już na koncie 10, a w poprzednim meczu pokonało Estoril 4:0. O przedłużenie tej imponującej serii podopieczni Francesco Farioliego powalczą w 11. kolejce na wyjeździe z Vitorią SC.

programme.title: Dramatyczne rzuty karne
programme.desc: Rzuty karne w piłce nożnej to ogromne emocje towarzyszące zarówno biorącym w nich udział piłkarzom, jak i obserwującym je kibicom. Szczęście, nerwy ze stali i umiejętności techniczne są potrzebne, by dobrze wykonywać rzuty karne. Umiejętność ta jest bardzo ważna, bo strzały z jedenastu metrów rozstrzygały o losach niejednego ważnego spotkania.

programme.title: Basketball - NBA League: San Antonio - Detroit
programme.desc: The sixth day of June, back in 1946, would forever change the game of basketball. On that day, the world's most elite basketball competition, the NBA League, was founded in New York. 29 teams from the USA and one from Canada start hunting for the legendary ring intended for the NBA champion every fall. The teams are divided into Eastern and Western Conferences, and through 82 games of the regular season, they are chasing one of the eight positions for the playoffs. The conference champions enter the big NBA finals, where they decide on the new champion in a series of a maximum of seven games. The NBA Finals is one of the most followed sports events of the year, which delights all basketball lovers.

programme.title: Basketball - Euroleague: Partizan - Valencia
programme.desc: The Euroleague is a competition that began its journey into the world of European basketball under the name European Champions Cup way back in 1958, and the first trophy was won by the ASK Riga team from the then USSR, i.e. today's Latvia. FIBA had the main say in this competition until 2000 when the clubs took control of the competition through their association Eurolegaue Basketball. The format of the competition has changed throughout history and included a group stage followed by eliminations in the playoffs. The winner of this competition is decided at the final tournament called the Final Four. The most successful clubs in this competition are Real Madrid, CSKA Moscow, Maccabi Tel-Aviv, Panathinaikos, Varese, Olympiakos.

programme.title: Basketball - Eurocup: Manresa - PAOK
programme.desc: Eurocup was created in 2002 as the second competition of Euroleague Basketball. The strongest basketball clubs that fail to qualify for the Euroleague compete in this competition, and mostly clubs from the top 15 strongest European leagues participate in it. programme.desc: The VTB League brings together the best basketball clubs from Eastern and Northern Europe. In addition to the dominant Russian clubs, clubs from Belarus, Estonia, Kazakhstan and Latvia also participate in the league. Throughout the history of the league, which was launched in 2008, other clubs from Lithuania and Ukraine participated. Starting with the 2013-2014 season. The VTB League is also the national championship for Russian clubs, of which the best placed becomes the champion of Russia. In order for clubs to join the league, they must have a hall with a minimum capacity of 3,000 spectators. The name of the VTB League comes from the general sponsor of the league, VTB Bank. FIBA Europe officially recognized the league in 2013.

programme.title: Handball - EHF Europa League: Overview of the 4th round
programme.desc: The EHF Cup, the second most important competition for men's handball clubs in Europe, began its journey in 1993. Until then, this competition was called the IHF Cup, which played its first season in the 1981-1982 season. Since 2012, the former EHF Cup Winners' Cup has been added to the EHF Cup. The competition, like the Champions League, consists of a part where the clubs play in groups and the best ones go to the knock out phase. After the quarter-finals with two games between the opponents, the final four follows. The semifinals and finals as well as the third place match are played on a one-game winning basis.

programme.title: Basketball - FIBA Champions League: Galatasaray - Legia
programme.desc: One of the youngest continental competitions for basketball players in Europe is the new Fibina Basketball Champions League. The goal of this league is to compete with the organization Euroleague Basketball S.L. and its Euroleague, which includes the strongest European clubs. In such a league, clubs acquire the right to perform based on their placement in their own national championships, while in the Euroleague, the right to perform is acquired based on licenses. The competition system consists of two rounds of qualifications, a regular part, a playoff and a final tournament of the best four, or popularly known as the Fayball Four. The final is held at the end of April.

programme.title: Basketball - Euroleague: Bayern - Baskonia
programme.desc: The Euroleague is a competition that began its journey into the world of European basketball under the name European Champions Cup way back in 1958, and the first trophy was won by the ASK Riga team from the then USSR, i.e. today's Latvia. FIBA had the main say in this competition until 2000 when the clubs took control of the competition through their association Eurolegaue Basketball. The format of the competition has changed throughout history and included a group stage followed by eliminations in the playoffs. The winner of this competition is decided at the final tournament called the Final Four. The most successful clubs in this competition are Real Madrid, CSKA Moscow, Maccabi Tel-Aviv, Panathinaikos, Varese, Olympiakos.

programme.title: Football - Brazilian league: Vasco - Internacional

Only with the development of civil aviation did Brazil get a unique football league. There are currently 20 teams participating in the league in a two-round competition system. During its existence, Serie A has given the soccer world some of the best players in history. Pele, Socrates, Garrincha and Ronaldinho are just one of them. In addition to the dominant Russian clubs, clubs from Belarus, Estonia, Kazakhstan and Latvia also participate in the league. Throughout the history of the league, which was launched in 2008, other clubs from Lithuania and Ukraine participated. Starting with the 2013-2014 season. The VTB League is also the national championship for Russian clubs, of which the best placed becomes the champion of Russia.
